messages:
nate: Heads-up — we need a hotfix pushed to prod for the prompt-escaping regression. Seeing ~0.8% bad generations since 11:30 UTC. Can we fast-track?
carla: is this the tokenizer edge-case from yesterday? severity?
ashley: Confirmed. It breaks a small subset of customer prompts (quotes + backslashes). Severity: medium but customer-facing; asked for expedited push.
mike: what's the minimal changelist? can we skip canary?
andre: patch is tiny: pin tokenization map update + test. 3 LOC. Risk low but touches tokenizer cache invalidation. Prefer one canary node first.
nate: timeline: patch + build in 20m, canary deploy 10m, smoke 10m, full roll 20m. We need approvals to skip normal 2h change window.
carla: tagging legal/compliance? No PII involved. fine.
ashley: ops: do we need DB migrations?
andre: no migrations. runtime-only. KV cache bump needs coordinated invalidate on canary only.
mike: ops oncall pls review. @deploy-bot please create a fasttrack request and run preflight.
deploy-bot: @channel creating hotfix run: id=hotfix-1779991110
```
preflight checks: unit-tests: passed
integration-smoke: queued
canary-available: eu-west1(2 nodes)
rollout-strategy: canary->90%->100%
```
carla: adding release note stub to the notes doc: "Fix: tokenizer escaping issue causing malformed outputs for quoted prompts."
nate: approval please (prod-change expeditor): @ashley @mike @andre
ashley: +1 :thumbsup: (reviewed code, small change)
mike: +1, want metrics alert on generation-error-rate to watch during canary
andre: +1, ops ready to invalidate cache on canary and watch KV hit-rate
carla: I'll prepare the rollout blurb and postmortem template in #postmortems in case we need it
deploy-bot: preflight results: unit-tests: passed, e2e: passed, perf-smoke: within threshold
deploy-bot: canary-1 deploy started -> eu-west1-node-a
nate: monitoring: creating quickdash with error-rate and rouge-token-count; sharing in 5m
ashley: canary alive, smoke ok after 7m
mike: observed slight increase in tokenization-ms on canary (+6ms) but within SLO
andre: starting cache invalidate on canary node now
carla: can we pin the model version in the release to avoid surprise model changes? put model=redwood-chat-2.1.4 in notes
nate: pinned: model=redwood-chat-2.1.4, runtime=tokenizer-v3.2
mike: after 12m of stable canary, request moving to gradual 90%
ashley: moving rollout to 90% -> deploy-bot initiating
deploy-bot: rollout to 90% complete (eu-west1=90%), monitoring 10m window
andre: metrics look green, no increase in bad-gen-rate, KV hit-rate steady
carla: prepping customer comms for impacted tenants; sending draft to support for review
mike: heads-up: if error-rate >0.5% rollback decision point is immediate PB (auto-rollback), else manual review
ashley: 10m mark: all stable. propose full 100%
nate: +1 final, go to 100%
deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete
carla: posting release note and changelog entry now. cc @support-team
ashley: great job team — expedited approval granted and executed. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if anything odd shows up.
andre: minor follow-up: will open a follow-up PR to add a unit test to catch this escaping condition
mike: linking metrics dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/prod-hotfix-1779991110
nate: closing thread and adding tags: hotfix, expedited, tokenizer, canary
deploy-bot: hotfix-1779991110 status: SUCCESS
